[Tenek nods Cassian in the right direction] "''I'm sorry about your mother.|Cassian Andor and Tenek|}} '''Tenek''' was a [[human]] [[Chef|cook]] who worked at [[Hotel Rix]]''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] while the building was [[Ferrix occupation|used]] as a base of operation by the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|112}} Tenek entered the kitchen with a tray while a [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]] procession was taking place outside for the local [[Gender|woman]] [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]]. Once in the kitchen, Tenek found himself held at [[blaster]] point by Maarva's son, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian]], but the intruder lowered the weapon once he recognized the cook. Andor had snuck into the building to find [[Bix Caleen]], a [[prisoner]] of the Empire being held there, and he asked Tenek where she was being held. The cook silently nodded him in the right direction, passing on his condolences over Maarva's [[death]]. Andor then rescued Caleen and escaped without the alarm being raised. Tenek had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. While in the kitchen, he wore a brown outfit including an apron and a [[hat]]. ==Behind the scenes== Tenek was portrayed by [[Gavin Spokes]] in "[[Rix Road (episode)|Rix Road]]," the twelfth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[November 23]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like.
